title: digitsPattern
summary: Create a pattern matching digit characters.

gpu_support.notes: Pattern construction is a host operation. The documented count controls are host scalars, and resident controls reject before provider access.

fusion.notes: Not eligible for fusion; this builtin materializes host text or logical results.

description: `digitsPattern` creates a greedy pattern for Unicode digit characters. It supports one-or-more matching, an exact count, or inclusive minimum and maximum counts.

inputs.name: N
inputs.description: Exact nonnegative number of Unicode digit characters.

inputs.name: maxCharacters
inputs.description: Inclusive nonnegative maximum count, or positive infinity.

behaviors: With no inputs, the pattern matches one or more Unicode digit characters.
A single nonnegative integer scalar matches exactly that many digits.
Two nonnegative integer scalars specify inclusive minimum and maximum counts; positive infinity is accepted as an unbounded maximum, and matching is greedy toward the maximum.
Count controls accept host single, double, and every built-in integer class. Fractional, negative, logical, and resident controls reject.
examples: contains("A12", digitsPattern) can match the digit run through pattern-aware string APIs.
